def count_infected(grid, i, j):
    """Counts infected cells (1s) in the 2x2 starting at (i, j)."""
    return grid[i:i+2, j:j+2].sum()

def get_steriles(grid, i, j):
    """Returns coordinates of sterile cells (0s) in the 2x2 starting at (i, j)."""
    steriles = []
    for r in range(i, i+2):
        for c in range(j, j+2):
            if grid[r, c] == 0:
                steriles.append((r, c))
    return steriles

def simulate_step(grid):
    """Applies the spread rules simultaneously to generate the next grid state."""
    N = grid.shape[0]
    new_grid = grid.copy()

    # Iterate over all possible top-left corners of a 2x2 square
    for i in range(N - 1):
        for j in range(N - 1):
